source: Tamil Nadu Disaster Management Policy, 2023; Revenue Administration & Disaster Management G.O. Ms. No. 380
land_authority: Village Administrative Officer (VAO) / Firka Revenue Inspector (RI)

administrative_tiers.state_authority: Tamil Nadu Disaster Risk Reduction Agency (TNDRRA)

land_record: Digital Patta / Chitta extract from TN e-Services portal
VAO field verification certificate countersigned by Firka RI
ration_card: TN Smart Card (PDS / TNePDS portal) electronic beneficiary record
house_ownership: Village Panchayat property tax receipt or TANGEDCO power consumption bill
Aapke Liye coastal geo-tagged damage evidence
